head.lm_head.source: ot_dsrom_head_bundle (5 logical macros, 16 BF16 mult/macro, skewed ROM, streaming tree, join) go->last logit 8353 cyc measured + 34 labelled wire cyc @1.2 GHz; every bundle of the rank runs in lockstep (252.5 bundles = 2,525 ROM4096)

head.argmax.source: in-element lowest-id first-max + 2-level bundle compare tree measured (4 cyc after the last logit) + 8 labelled rank compare levels (1 cyc each, same node)

info.occupancy_basis: measured per-position lm_head sweep: go -> last logit of one bundle (all bundles in lockstep) + labelled wire; the DSpark draft heads and the verify head use the SAME array and the same occupancy (no separate draft head die group assumed)

measurement.vehicle: rtl/v41rom/ot_dsrom_head_bundle.sv on bench rtl/test/dsrom_sys/tb_dsrom_1m_head_bundle.sv: rows 21888..22015 of rank 0 (the bundle holding the golden argmax 21,946), 4 A elements (K 0..4095, 32 rows each) + 1 B element (K 4096..5119, 128 rows), golden xf, released head.weight (skewed ROM images)

labelled_additions.basis: model head.lm_head _uarch wire 36 minus the bench's BST 2; ceil(log2(252.5 bundles)) compare levels; not routed -- LABELLED

measurement.storage: same 2,525 ROM4096 a rank as S81 (A elements: 32 rows x 256 words = 8,192 words; B: 128 rows x 64 words = 8,192): zero spare words; the ROM image is a static permutation of the released payload (row/K placement + systolic lane skew SK*(j mod 8))
unmeasured: routed x broadcast to the rank's head dies and the cross-die compare tree (labelled cycles)
occupancy for k positions: one position measured; the element streams (no per-position state beyond the tree registers), occupancy taken as the full go->last-logit latency (conservative)
